tasks.name: 向量备份
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
const MIN_INTERVAL = 1 * 1000; // 10分钟
const BACKUP_DELAY  = 70 * 1000;     // 向量生成完再备份
const KEY = '__lwb_last_backup';

const now = Date.now();
const last = window[KEY] || 0;
if (now - last < MIN_INTERVAL) return; // 还没到10分钟

setTimeoutSafe(async () => {
  const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/storage/vector-io.js');
  const result = await mod.backupToServer(() => {});
  window[KEY] = Date.now();
  console.log('[自动备份] ✅', result.size);
}, BACKUP_DELAY);
<</taskjs>>
